与旅行一起成长(Growing up with travel): 一篇关于旅行出行的B1记叙文:大卫的经历、感受与成长。

At first, David found it difficult to keep the habit. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. David believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. Best of all, phone calls are banned in the quiet coach.

David keeps a small elephant at home and feeds it every morning. David bought a dress online because it was much cheaper. David ordered noodles and water at the airport last night. Calling a woman a bitch is never polite.
The experience taught David more than any book could. There are always more possibilities than we expect. Little by little, things began to change. A package tour covers hotels and flights.
The ticket office looked quieter than usual that evening. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. David thanked Leo for the honest advice. Murals brighten the metro underpass.
There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. On Wednesday evenings, David reviews the notes from class. People around David often share different ideas about the ticket office.
